title: The app garden got easier to explore
summary:
A community-heavy day: better app discovery, video duration metadata, repaired API docs, and more honest model plumbing.

The ecosystem directory now supports shareable search URLs, a cleaner all-apps default, reorganized browsing controls, and a more visible Docs card. Two new image tools joined the directory too: REKTY GENERATOR, an open-source multi-model image interface, and ArtScape Studio, a bilingual configurable art studio. The README also received its regular field report on recent apps and project activity.

Video model endpoints and SDK types now expose minimum, maximum, default, and supported duration values. Apps can build valid duration pickers for models such as Veo, Wan, and Nova Reel instead of treating video length as a small mystery with a dropdown attached.

OpenAPI schema generation now handles prompt-agent messages with a JSON Schema-compatible definition, while the Markdown docs pipeline correctly includes managed-agent, account, community-model, and agent routes. Tag descriptions also make it through to the generated docs, where they belong.

highlights.title: Videos learn to count
highlights.text: Video model endpoints and SDK types now expose supported minimum, maximum, default, and stepped durations—so apps can offer controls that match the model instead of asking nicely and hoping. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: OpenRouter takes the direct path
highlights.text: Chat requests to OpenRouter models now preserve requested provider routing plus OpenRouter’s raw usage and cost data, in streaming and non-streaming calls. [Chat API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions)

highlights.title: One garden, many brushes
highlights.text: REKTY GENERATOR joins the app directory: an open-source image workspace with Pollinations generation alongside 57+ models. [Try it](https://visualaiartwork.pages.dev)

highlights.title: A new canvas blooms
highlights.text: ArtScape Studio brings a bilingual AI art workspace with idea, aspect-ratio, style, and seed controls for Pollinations-powered images. [Try it](https://creatneworld.github.io/artscape-studio)
